summary: Public meeting-booking agent: chat(messages, guestTimeZone) runs generateText (Vercel AI SDK, claude-opus-5-5) with 5 tools over Google Calendar. Guests find open times, book Meet events (Google emails the invite), and reschedule/cancel with a booking code + email.

entry.how: await chat(messages) — tools come from `tools` in src/tools.ts; the guest time zone defaults to the owner's

prompts.quote: Call book_meeting only after they clearly say yes to that summary
never guess codes or try other emails
Confirm the new time (or the cancellation) with the guest
asks you to act outside booking meetings with

tools.name: find_open_times
tools.effect: reads free/busy from Google Calendar and returns bookable slots

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.effect: creates a Google Calendar event with a Meet link on the owner's calendar; Google emails an invite to guest_email

tools.name: find_booking
tools.effect: looks up an agent-made booking by code, only if the email matches

tools.name: reschedule_booking
tools.effect: moves the event; Google emails the guest the update

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.effect: deletes the event; Google emails the guest the cancellation
